name: R&D Pacing and Coordination
summary: The lab slows or stops training and deploying more capable models when its safeguards are not ready, alone or together with other labs.
description: Most labs say that they do not slow down because others do not. Limits that are set in advance, and a pledge to slow down together, make it easier for each lab to act in time.

criteria.label: Own Trigger
criteria.description: The lab stops by itself when evaluations pass a threshold and the required safeguards are not ready. A slowdown with no stop is partly met.

criteria.label: Covers Training
criteria.description: The limit covers training, not only release.

criteria.label: Coordinated Pacing
criteria.description: The lab will slow or stop if other leading labs or governments agree to do the same.

criteria.label: No Race Exception
criteria.description: No clause lets the lab continue because competitors continue.

orgs.summary: OpenAI stops development at Critical risk and proposes shared limits across labs, but may adjust if rivals lack safeguards. California alleges unsafe testing.

events.title: Pauses reinforcement learning training for two weeks
events.summary: Says it paused RL training on models meant for deployment for two weeks to harden research environments, and that its largest planned frontier RL run remains on hold.

quote.text: This included a two-week pause in reinforcement learning (RL) training on our latest models intended for deployment while we further hardened and red-teamed our research environments and expanded the coverage of our monitoring systems.

events.title: Backs shared rules on when development should stop
events.summary: Says it will slow or stop systems it cannot safeguard, and will advocate international approaches on when development should slow or stop. Its chief scientist hopes voluntary slowdowns become common.

quote.text: We will advocate for compatible international approaches to measuring capabilities, managing risk, preserving human control, and determining when and how development should slow or stop, even if that means slowing the advancement of model capabilities.

sources.title: The AI policy window is open. We need to act.

events.title: Scraps a model release that missed its safety bar

quote.text: We believe we are entering a new era in which structured safety documentation should be required before continuing any frontier reinforcement learning training run.
